senses.gloss: द्विज- + अग्र्य द्विज- + अग्र्य, m. a Brāhmaṇa, Man. 3, 35.
द्विधा- + आकार द्विधा- + आकार, adj., of two kinds, Pañc. iii. d. 35.
द्विज- + ईश्वर द्विज- + ईश्वर, m. the moon, Hariv. 2476.
द्विज- + उत्तम द्विज- + उत्तम, m. a Brāhmaṇa, Man. 2, 49.

द्वि- + गुणित द्वि- + गुणित, adj. double, Kir. 5, 46.
 2. † To invite.
द्वि- + जन्मन् द्वि- + जन्मन्, m. a man of either of the three first classes, especially a Brāhmaṇa (cf. द्विज), Man. 2, 26; Rājat. 4, 105.
द्वि- + जाति द्वि- + जाति, m. a man of either of the three first classes, especially a Brāhmaṇa (cf. द्विज), Man. 10, 4; Bhāg. P. 6, 11, 15.

द्वि- + जिह्व द्वि- + जिह्व,
 I. adj. 1. having two tongues, MBh. 1, 1543. 2. treacherous, Pañc. i. d. 74.
 II. m. a snake, Rām. 2, 42, 2 Gorr.
द्विस्- + तावन्त् द्विस्- + तावन्त्, twice as much, Hariv. 6927.
द्वि- + दल द्वि- + दल, adj. broken, Hariv. 15522.

द्वि द्वि, the base of the declension is द्व, m. n.; द्वा, f.; du. numeral,
 1. Two.
 2. Both, Rām. 6, 95, 44.
 --Cf. δύο, δυάκις,, etc., δεύτερος, δί-τυλος, διά, δίζω; Lat. duo, bi-farius, dubius, duellum, bellum, dis-; Goth. tvai; A.S. tvá, twi-, tweogan; Goth. tveifljan, tvi-standan, dis-dailjan.

द्विक द्वि + क,
 I. adj. Increased by [] two, Man. 8, 141 (two in the hundred).
 II. (n.) A pair, Rājat. 1, 56.
द्विगुणत्व द्वि-गुण + त्व, n. Duplication, Amar. 6. 8.

द्विज द्वि-ज,
 I. adj. Twice born.
 II. m.
 1. A man of either of the three first classes, as their initiation passes for a second birth, especially a Brāhamaṇa, Yājñ. 1, 39; Nal. 16, 1.
 2. A bird, Man. 5, 17.
 3. A tooth, Bhartṛ. 1, 12.
 --Comp.
द्विजत्व द्विज-त्व, n. Condition or state of a Brāhmaṇa, Rājat. 4, 105.
द्विजातिसात् द्वि-जाति + सात्, adv. (A present) to the Brāhmaṇas, Rājat. 5, 120.
द्वित द्वित, m. The name of a mythical person, MBh. 12, 13174.

द्वितय द्वि + तय,
 I. adj.
 1. Involved in duality, Bhāg. P. 6, 15, 28.
 2. Both, Ragh. 8, 89.
 II. n. A pair, two, Bhāg. P. 5, 22, 14.

द्वितीय द्वि + तीय,
 I. ordinal number, f. या,
 1. Second, Man. 2, 169. ˚यम्, adv. A second time, again, Man. 11, 232.
 II. m. A companion, MBh. 13, 4899.
 --Comp.
द्वितीयवन्त् द्वितीय + वन्त्, adj. Having a friend, MBh. 3, 17333.
द्वित्र द्वित्र, i. e. द्वि-त्रि + अ, m., f. त्रा, n. pl. Two or three, Bhartṛ. 2, 90.
द्वित्रिचतुरम् द्वि-त्रि-चतुर् + अ + म्, adv. Twice, or three or four times, Daśak. in Chr. 193, 8.
द्वित्व द्वि + त्व. n. The number Two, Bhāṣāp. 88.

द्विधा द्वि + धा, adv.
 1. In two parts, Man. 1, 12.
 2. Divided, Sāv. 4, 33.
 3. Of two kinds, Sāh. D. 8.
 --Cf. δίχα, διχθά, δισσός.

द्विप द्वि-प (1. पा), m. An elephant (drinking twice, the elephant imbibing fluids by his trunk and thence conveying them to his mouth), Man. 7, 192.
 --Comp.

द्वीप द्वीप, i. e. द्वि-अप् + अ, m. and n.
 1. An island, Rām. 2, 25, 34.
 2. Shelter, MBh. 2, 2118.
 3. The name of the four, seven, or thirteen grand divisions of the terrestrial world, each of these being separated from the next by a different circumambient ocean, MBh. 6, 404.
 --Comp.
द्विपदिका द्विपदिका, i. e. द्वि-पद + क, f. A kind of song, Vikr. 51, 5.
द्विपायिन् द्विपायिन्, i. e. द्वि- 1. पा + इन्, m. An elephant. (cf. द्विप), Rām. 3, 30, 26.
द्विमातृ द्वि-मातृ, adj. Having two mothers (Sch., the measurer of the two worlds), Chr. 296, 4 = Rigv. i. 112, 4.
द्विशस् द्वि-शस्, adv. Two by two, Suśr. 1, 152, 18.
द्वि- + षष् द्वि- + षष्, twelve Bhāg. P. 4, 1, 7.

1. द्विष् द्विष्, ii. 2 (in epic poetry also i. 6, MBh. 2, 1934; 1943), Par. Ātm.
 1. To hate, MBh. 12, 8051.
 2. To show one's hatred, Man. 7, 12.
 3. To dislike, Bhag. 2, 57.
 --Ptcple. of the pres. द्विषन्त्, m. A foe, Man. 3, 144.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. द्विष्ट,
 1. Odious, Yājñ. 2, 304.
 2. Hostile, Hariv. 4673.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. द्वेष्य,
 1. Disagreeable, MBh. 4, 120.
 2. Odious, Rām. 2, 21, 57. m. A foe, Man. 9, 307.
 --With अनु अनु, To wreak one's anger upon one, Bhāg. P. 1, 18, 7.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To dislike, Bhag. 16, 18.
 2. To hate, MBh. 14, 789.
 3. To show one's hatred, MBh. 12, 8397.
 --With वि वि, To dislike, Hariv. 8395. विद्विषन्त्, m. A foe, Bhartṛ. 3, 68. वि-द्विष्ट,
 1. Odious, Man. 2, 57.
 2. [] Being in contradiction to, Rām. 2, 116, 46 Gorr.
 --With सम् सम्, संद्विष्ट, Hated, MBh. 12, 53.
 --Cf. ὠδυσάμην, ὀδύσσομαι (frequent.), ὀδυσσάμενος, probably also δέδια, ἔδδεισα, δείδια, δείδοικα, δεῖος, δέος; δέαρ, δειδίσσομαι (frequent.), δεδίσσομαι, δειλός, δεινός, etc.; Lat. in -vϊsus, dirus.

2. द्विष् द्विष्,
 I. latter part of comp. adj. Hating, Man. 3, 41.
 II. m. A foe, MBh. 4, 509.
 --Comp.

द्विस् द्वि + स्, adv. Twice, Man. 2, 60.
 --Cf. δίς; Lat. bis.

द्वीपवन्त् द्वीप + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Abounding in islands, MBh. 1, 2872.
 --Cf. त्रयोदशद्वीपवन्त् i. e. त्रयोदशन्-, adj., f. वती, Containing thirteen द्वीपस्, MBh. 3, 182. सप्तन्-, adj. Containing seven द्वीपस्, Bhāg. P. 3, 21, 2.
द्वीपिन् द्वीपिन्, i. e. द्वीप + इन्, m. on ounce or panther, Pañc. 63, 22.
द्वि- + नवति द्वि- + नवति, ninety-two, MBh. 1, adhy. 192.

एक-, द्वि-, त्रि-, चतुर्-, पञ्चन्-, षष्-, सप्तन्-, अष्टन्- + नवतितम एक-, द्वि-, त्रि-, चतुर्-, पञ्चन्-, षष्-, सप्तन्-, अष्टन्- + नवतितम, ninetyfirst, second, third, fourth, etc., Rām. 2, adhy. 91 sqq.

द्वि-पद् द्वि-पद् and -पाद्, f. पाद् and पदी,
 I. adj. having two feet.
 II. m. a man, MBh. 1, 257.
 III. n. mankind.
द्वि- + पद द्वि- + पद, m. a man, Bhāg. P. 4, 31, 22.
द्वि- + पाद द्वि- + पाद, adj., f. दी, biped.
द्वि-ज- + मुख्य द्वि-ज- + मुख्य, and द्वि-जाति-, m. A Brāhmaṇa, MBh. 5, 7279; Man. 3, 286.

द्वि- + रद द्वि- + रद,
 I. adj. having two teeth.
 II. m. an elephant, Rām. 4, 9, 62.
द्विज- + राज द्विज- + राज and नक्षत्र-, m. the moon, Ragh. 5, 23; Rām. 5, 18, 17.
द्वि- + रेफ द्वि- + रेफ, m. A sort of bee (properly containing two र्ऽs in its name भ्रमर), Hariv. 4585.
द्वि- + लक्षण द्वि- + लक्षण, adj. of two kinds, Man. 7, 163.
द्वि-गुण- + लाभ द्वि-गुण- + लाभ, m. (condition of) receiving something doubled, Pañc. 88, 9.
द्विज- + लिङ्गिन् द्विज- + लिङ्गिन्, adj. one who wears the marks of a twice-born (i. e. one of the three first castes), Man. 9, 224.
द्विज- + वर द्विज- + वर, m. a Brāhmaṇa, Kathās. 25, 254.
द्विज- + वाहन द्विज- + वाहन, m, Viṣṇu (having a bird, Garuḍa, as his vehicle), Hariv. 3982.
द्रि- + विध द्रि- + विध, adj. of two sorts, Man. 7, 162.

द्वि- + शत द्वि- + शत,
 I. n. 1. two hundred. 2. hundred and two.
 II. adj. 1. amounting to two hundred, Man. 8, 257. 2. two hundredth, MBh. i. adhy. 200, sqq.
द्वि- + शततम द्वि- + शततम, adj. two hundredth, Hariv. adhy. 200.
द्वि- + शफ द्वि- + शफ, adj. and sbst. any cloven-footed animal, [] Man. 11, 168.
द्वि- + शिरस् द्वि- + शिरस्, adj. having two heads, Pañc. 251, 24.
द्वि- + सप्ततितम द्वि- + सप्ततितम, seventy-second.
द्वि- + सप्तधा द्वि- + सप्तधा, adv. in fourteen parts, Bhāg. P. 3, 10, 8.
द्विट्सेविन् द्विट्सेविन्, i. e. द्विष्-, m. a traitor, Man. 9, 232.
